name: do_action
description: Perform an action on a record: pay a bill, mark obligation paid, complete maintenance, or delete any record.

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: Action to perform: pay (bills), mark_paid (obligations), complete (maintenance), delete (any)

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Record ID (optional if match is provided)

parameters.name: match
parameters.description: Text to match against records (e.g. MSEB, Netflix, AC Service)
